item.text: [{"task_id":"bda2d7a6","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    palette = []","    for value in grid.flatten():","        color = int(value)","        if color not in palette:","            palette.append(color)","    colors = np.array(palette)","    out = grid.copy()","    for i in range(len(palette)):","        value = int(round(np.sum(params['mix'][i, :len(palette)] * colors)))","        value = int(np.minimum(np.max(colors), np.maximum(np.min(colors), value)))","        out[grid == palette[i]] = value","    return out"],"shapes":{"mix":[3,3]},"params":{"mix":[[0,0,1],[1,0,0],[0,1,0]]},"rationale":"Order the three colors by first appearance, which follows the nested rings from outside inward.
